description: Invigilator: reviewer agents stay read-only, and builders pass QA after their last edit before they stop. Each command runs hooks/run.sh in sh or Git Bash; on Windows without Git Bash, PowerShell skips the first line and runs hooks/run.ps1 from the second.

hooks.command:
exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" session_status
powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run.ps1" session_status

exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" reviewer_readonly
powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run.ps1" reviewer_readonly

exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" qa_before_done
powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run.ps1" qa_before_done

exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" qa_before_done
powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run.ps1" qa_before_done
